svg.title: Crab Robot—all wiring on one sheet
svg.desc: LILYGO component-side pin photo tagged A3V,BGND,C18,D17,E1. A goes to PCA VCC3.3V,B to GND,C to SDA,D to SCL,E to LED DIN. Separate 5 V supplies servos and LEDs through V+, not VCC. Only servo sockets0 through7 are used. Photos are supplied references, not a verified power setup.

g.text: LILYGO T-Display-S3 non-touch + PCA9685 · match printed labels
LILYGO back/component side · USB-C down · photo tags match the lead list
18 is below 44;17 is below 18. Use 18/17, not Arduino A4/A5. OE stays unconnected.
Output 2 uses a labelled USB-to-terminal adapter.
Red is the middle wire. Find the GND row
before choosing which way round to plug it in.
Hip = on body · Knee = on leg · CH8–CH15 stay empty
VCC = 3.3 V LOGIC | V+ = 5 V SERVO POWER | KEEP THE GROUND LEAD CONNECTED
